timing: Written after the model-0 numerical pilot and before any R6 synthetic-anomaly scores.

data.normal_reference: 3232 normal validation realizations, with independently drawn pooled shape noise seeded by 978000 plus source ID. Used to fit empirical statistic CDFs only; these clean realizations previously selected neural checkpoints.
data.normal_calibration: The same 3232 observed calibration maps used by the existing field/summary ensemble, copied exactly from the R2 field benchmark cache.
data.diagnostics: The existing R4 closure cache: 3232 normal maps in float32, the same maps after float16 roundtrip, and eight synthetic families with 404 examples each. This is reused diagnostic evidence, not blind validation.

predefined_statistics: The five definitions in PLAN.json. Average the two frozen models' scalar statistics for each individual map; no latent-axis or pixel averaging between models.
normal_reference_transform: For a statistic s and sorted normal-validation reference v of size n, q(s)=(searchsorted(v,s,side=right)+0.5)/(n+1). This is a frozen pointwise transform. It saturates at finite tails, creates ties and is not an exact p-value.
combinations: Report every standalone statistic, both combinations, and fixed equal-mean/max combinations with candidate 08, using normal-calibration medians and q90-minus-median scales.
Candidate 09 is an unchanged contextual baseline. Do not optimize mixture weights against these synthetic families.
verification: Run the numerical pilot on both frozen field models and resolve 64-vs-128-step accuracy before large evaluation.
Check identical normal and closure cache hashes across all lab hosts.
Verify every requested row is covered exactly once per model, all scores are finite, and per-model source/config/weight hashes match.
Use the official low-FPR metric and report normal false-positive counts at 5%, 1% and 0.1%, plus paired float16 sensitivity and every synthetic regression.
limitations: Neither the reference CDFs nor a reused synthetic benchmark identify the hidden competition alternatives.
The small-FPR tail uses few independent normal observations. Empirical quantile ties are retained, not broken using public-test ranks.
Empirical model-selection diagnostics do not establish the paper's theoretical error-control assumptions or a SOTA result.
public_test: Not read. Candidates 04 through 09 stay frozen.
